title: Europe has its first commercial orbital rocket
snippet: German company Isar Aerospace has successfully launched Europe's first entirely commercial orbital rocket. It attempted to achieve the feat last March, but that lasted all of 30 seconds before the vehicle crashed into the sea and exploded. This time the company managed to get the two-stage Spectrum into low Earth orbit from a Norwegian spaceport. title: Amazon accused of rigging ad auctions to inflate prices in new suit filed by FTC and 22 states
snippet: State attorneys general and federal regulators have sued Amazon, alleging the tech giant deceptively inflated advertising prices by $20 billion through fake auction participants and hidden surcharges. Amazon denies the claims, arguing that its pricing structure reflects standard industry approaches and relies on ad relevance, boosting performance for advertisers. Read More

title: Incore Bank trials AI for customer onboarding with automated risk assessment
